title: Release Shared Test Drift
objective: Update shared release tests to assert the exact platform-specific FFLAS cache provenance emitted when a custom FLINT prefix is selected

oracles: Focused parallel-development regression test asserts exact fflas-dependencies and fflas-addon miss records

handoff.summary: The custom-FLINT-prefix regression now preserves Linux's aggregate FFLAS skip while requiring the ordered fflas-dependencies and fflas-addon cache misses on Darwin and Windows, matching the existing production dependency model without loosening IDs, statuses, or ordering.
risks: Linux exercises the shared-prefix branch locally; the release macOS job supplies real-host coverage of the independent FFLAS branch.
next_steps: Run the focused test on real macOS arm64 and integrate only after independent review.
